# device42_customer_contact (Datasource)

Reseach customer contact using different parameters.

## Exemple 

```hcl
data "device42_customer_contact" "searchContact" {
    customer = "acmeCorp"
    name     = "John Doe"
}

data "device42_customer_contact" "searchContact2" {
    contact_id = 1
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `customer` (String) Name of the parent customer.
- `name` (String) Name of the contact.
- `contact_id` (Number) ID of the contact.

### Computed

- `address` (String) Address of the contact.
- `email` (String) Email of the contact.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `phone` (String) Phone of the contact.
- `type` (String) Type of the contact.
